items.change: Removes the redundant null guard around `getProperties().getLettuce()` in `applyProperties`, since the `Lettuce` properties object is always initialized, and keeps applying shutdown timeout and read-from settings directly from that instance.

Narrows `AxiosHeaders.toJSON()` overloads so `true` returns a string-only record and `false`/omitted returns a record whose values may be strings or string arrays, matching the actual runtime shapes more precisely.

title: fix(http): preserve basic auth on same-origin redirects (#6929)

items.change: Adds an internal `beforeRedirects.auth` hook and registers it during redirect setup so Basic credentials are restored on redirected requests only when the destination shares the original origin, while malformed redirect URLs still fail closed with auth stripped.

Adds regression coverage for same-origin 303 POST→GET redirects, cross-origin redirects, and multi-hop same-origin chains to verify Basic auth is preserved only for same-origin cases and remains stripped across origins.
Records the fix as an unreleased bug-fix entry.

title: ♻️ Do not accept underscore headers when using `convert_underscores=True` (the default)

items.change: Adjusts request parameter processing so header fields using the default underscore-to-hyphen conversion are marked as handled under both names, preventing the original underscore alias from being treated as an allowed extra header.
Adds a header model and regression tests proving hyphenated headers are accepted by default, while underscore-only headers are rejected when `convert_underscores=True`.

Adds capability-checked zstd handling to the Node adapter and switches `Accept-Encoding` negotiation to use `transitional.advertiseZstdAcceptEncoding`, defaulting to the standard header unless the new opt-in flag is explicitly enabled.
Introduces the new `transitional.advertiseZstdAcceptEncoding` boolean option, validates it as a transitional setting, and sets its default to `false` so zstd advertising remains opt-in.
Removes the old top-level `advertiseZstd` request option from merge rules, reflecting the move to the transitional config namespace.
Updates the public request config types to remove `advertiseZstd` and expose `advertiseZstdAcceptEncoding` under `TransitionalOptions`.
Adjusts the zstd coverage test to enable the new transitional flag and verify that `zstd` is advertised only when supported and explicitly opted in.

title: Clean up error handling, fix a proto-pollution gap, and seal a few loose ends

items.change: Stops `resolveConfig` from reading inherited `params` and `paramsSerializer` by using the module’s `own()` guard, with tests confirming polluted prototype properties are ignored and never invoked.
Removes a stray `console.warn` from the abort-event error path and replaces it with a silent catch so emit failures stay internal.
Normalizes several thrown values to proper `new Error`/`new TypeError` construction in header, FormData streaming, and circular-reference checks, keeping error creation consistent.
Fixes the `AxiosURLSearchParams` import to use the correct relative path within the helpers directory (`./` instead of `../helpers/`).
Adds the missing `readonly name: 'CanceledError'` declaration to the CJS typings so they match `index.d.ts`.

title: 📝 Add docs references to central contributing docs

items.change: Adds `translations.md` to the set of recognized documentation files so the docs tooling includes it alongside the other central guides.
Registers `translations.md` as a source document for translation-related processing, keeping it in sync with the rest of the docs set.
Includes `translations.md` in the translation fixer’s tracked document list so fixes are applied to that guide as well.
